title: Multi-resolution HuBERT: Multi-resolution Speech Self-Supervised Learning with Masked Unit Prediction

layout.note: One central column of boxes from the waveform at the top to two unit-prediction heads at the bottom, a long skip arrow down the left side from f1 to f3, a right-hand detour for f2's output, and a quantizer cylinder at the bottom centre; all inside one large dashed rounded frame titled Multi-resolution HuBERT.

lesson: Print the paper's own symbols beside every module and signal, and draw the sequences as bars or squares in cloud-shaped containers with a dashed span for the masked part, so the figure doubles as a map of the method section.
